verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a customer data platform, since such products can ship self-hostable deployments. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of mParticle. Every item describes the vendor-hosted service, its APIs, Warehouse Sync into mParticle, and integrations, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
